blocks.text: In the Zscaler Admin Console, you can often edit, delete, or duplicate items you configure. For example, you can do so with policy rules and other administrative items you configure in the Zscaler Admin Console (e.g., users and locations).

blocks.item: Go to the item you want to edit. In this example, it is a location.
Go to the item you want to delete. In this example, it is a location.
Read the warning message that appears. The following is an example. If you are sure you want to delete the item, click Confirm.

blocks.text: Some items can be deleted by clicking an icon. To delete items with the Delete icon:

blocks.item: Go to the item you want to delete. In this example, it is a tenant profile.
Enter CONFIRM in the confirmation window that appears and then click Delete.

blocks.text: You can duplicate policy rules in the Zscaler Admin Console by clicking the Duplicate icon:
If you duplicate a rule, the newly created rule is identical to the existing one, with the exception of the value in the Rule Order field. The new rule shows the next available rule order value.
The process for duplicating (cloning) DLP dictionaries is different. To learn more, see Cloning Predefined DLP Dictionaries and Cloning DLP Engines.
